sampling_design.main_coverage: All train/dev records are in the main stage; there is no calibration subset.
sampling_design.near_template_definition: Same first 60 characters after casefolding and replacement of URLs, handles, phone-like strings, numbers, punctuation, and whitespace.
sampling_design.estimation: All corpus records receive a prediction, so prediction inclusion probability and design weight are both 1.

agent_visibility: Batch files expose item_id and text only. Gold entities and source hash are absent.
